notes.title: Bug Fix!
notes.notes: Fixed a progression blocker bug where upon loading a game, the ledger may incorrectly display an upgrade is available prematurely, based on the cost threshold for the previous upgrade tier.

notes.title: Inn Hand Playable on Steam Deck
notes.notes:
From the very beginning, I imagined Inn Hand as a perfect fit for the Steam Deck. With that in mind, I made sure the game was well optimized to support both gamepad controls on PC and, of course, the Steam Deck. After countless hours of testing and tweaking, I'm happy to say that Inn Hand runs smoothly and feels right at home whether you're playing on your desktop or taking your inn on the go.
